meta.name: secrets-management
meta.description: Implement secure secrets management for CI/CD pipelines using Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, or native platform solutions. Use when handling sensitive credentials, rotating secrets, or securing CI/CD environments.

copy.tagline: 保护 CI/CD 流水线中的敏感凭据免遭泄露
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在 CI/CD 中管理密钥却担心泄露风险
copy.tagline_en: Secure sensitive credentials in your CI/CD pipelines
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you handle secrets in CI/CD and worry about leaks

howto.what: 它指导你把 CI/CD 流水线里的 API key、数据库密码、TLS 证书等敏感信息从代码里挪进 Vault、AWS Secrets Manager 等密钥库,并给出读取配置、自动轮换脚本和密钥扫描钩子。
howto.when: 当你处理敏感凭据、轮换密钥,或需要加固 CI/CD 环境时接管。

say.text: 帮我把数据库密码从流水线代码里移到 Vault
say.note: 会给出 Vault 写入与读取的配置示例

say.text: 用 AWS Secrets Manager 给这个部署流程取密钥
say.note: 产出取密钥并在日志中掩码的步骤

say.text: 给这个仓库加一个提交前的密钥扫描钩子
say.note: 用 TruffleHog 扫到密钥就阻断提交

howto.what_en: It moves API keys, database passwords and TLS certificates out of pipeline code into Vault, AWS Secrets Manager or native stores, and produces the calling config, rotation scripts and secret-scanning hooks.
howto.when_en: Use it when handling sensitive credentials, rotating secrets, or securing CI/CD environments.

say_en.text: Move our database password out of the pipeline code into Vault
say_en.note: It returns Vault write and read config examples

say_en.text: Pull the secrets for this deploy from AWS Secrets Manager
say_en.note: It produces fetch-and-mask steps for the job

say_en.text: Add a pre-commit secret scanning hook to this repo
say_en.note: TruffleHog blocks the commit on a hit
